title: Meeting rooms
intro: Light-filled meeting rooms at Toynbee Hall for training, interviews, board meetings and small group sessions.

blocks.heading: Flexible spaces
paragraphs: Choose from a range of room sizes and layouts for team meetings, workshops and away days. Rooms are available seven days a week.

blocks.heading: Enquire
paragraphs: Call 020 7392 2920 or email events@toynbeehall.org.uk to check availability and ask about facilities.
